name: Review Shopify variant prices and availability with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Review Shopify prices for each variant

For e-commerce researchers comparing sizes, formats and SKUs from a known public Shopify store, collection or product URL.

### How it works
1. Read one bounded Shopify product snapshot with its public variants.
2. Wait for settled native product charges and verify the complete dataset before expanding variants.
3. Write one Sheet row per variant. Filter available or reviewAction, compare prices within the same currency, then follow sourceUrl to verify the offer.

### Setup
- [ ] Select Apify Header Auth on all five HTTP nodes: Authorization with Bearer followed by your token.
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Upsert review register.
- [ ] Create the **Variant Review** tab and import the exact [header CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/shopify-products-price-stock-monitor/n8n-variant-review/sheet-header.csv). Set spreadsheetId.
- [ ] Set storeUrl in Review settings and maximumResults from 1–10 products. More than 500 variants stops delivery; lower the product limit or narrow the URL.

### Reading repeated results
Run manually and sequentially. Existing keys update; unobserved older rows remain, so check observedAt. Empty results add no rows.

The template is free; Apify runs are paid. The $1 cap is a ceiling, not a run price. Repeats may be charged again. [Setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/shopify-products-price-stock-monitor/n8n-variant-review/README.md).

## 1. Choose the Shopify source
Set one storeUrl and maximumResults in Review settings. Add spreadsheetId and import the Variant Review header; store, collection and individual product URLs are supported.

## 2. Read one product snapshot
Run Shopify once starts paid collection. The lower branch reads the same run until it finishes; it never starts another snapshot automatically.

## 3. Verify products and settled charges
Check OUTPUT and native catalog/product counters before reading all products. Charges settled? waits on the same run when counters lag; incomplete coverage or inconsistent counts stop delivery.

## 4. Review individual variants
Expand each product into variant rows and upsert by source, product and variant ID. available means public buyability, not inventory quantity; variants are included in product charges, so do not sum the repeated run-charge column.
